## Prepare the data

This page reads the activity workbook directly so it can render in a fresh R session. Treatment assignments follow the channel groups used in Assignment 3.

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| message: false
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(lubridate)
library(ggplot2)

workbook <- file.path("..", "Assignment 3", "DAMdata.xlsx")
if (!file.exists(workbook)) {
  workbook <- file.path("posts", "Assignment 3", "DAMdata.xlsx")
}
if (!file.exists(workbook)) stop("Cannot locate Assignment 3/DAMdata.xlsx")

prepare_activity <- function(sheet) {
  raw <- read_excel(workbook, sheet = sheet, skip = 1)
  if (!"Time" %in% names(raw)) stop("Missing Time column in sheet: ", sheet)
  if (!inherits(raw$Time, "POSIXt")) {
    if (is.numeric(raw$Time)) stop("Numeric Time values require verification of the Excel date/time format.")
    raw$Time <- ymd_hms(raw$Time, quiet = TRUE)
  }
  if (anyNA(raw$Time)) stop("Missing or unparseable Time values in sheet: ", sheet)
  long <- raw %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -Time, names_to = "ID", values_to = "Activity") %>%
    mutate(
      channel = as.numeric(str_extract(ID, "[0-9]+")),
      Treatment = case_when(
        channel >= 1 & channel <= 8 ~ "Control",
        channel <= 16 & channel >= 9 ~ "0.15uM Serotonin",
        channel <= 24 & channel >= 17 ~ "1.5uM Serotonin",
        channel <= 32 & channel >= 25 ~ "15uM Serotonin",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
  if (!is.numeric(long$Activity)) stop("Activity must be numeric in sheet: ", sheet)
  if (anyNA(long$Activity)) stop("Missing activity values require review in sheet: ", sheet)
  if (any(long$Treatment == "Other")) stop("Unrecognized channel IDs in sheet: ", sheet)
  long %>%
    mutate(hour_bin = floor_date(Time, unit = "hour")) %>%
    group_by(hour_bin, Treatment) %>%
    summarise(Total_Activity = sum(Activity), .groups = "drop")
}

sum.mated <- prepare_activity("mated")
sum.nonmated <- prepare_activity("non-mated")
```

## Mated mosquitoes

```{r}
ggplot(sum.mated, aes(x = hour_bin, y = Total_Activity)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Treatment) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%H:%M") +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Total activity", title = "Mated mosquitoes")
```

## Non-mated mosquitoes

```{r}
ggplot(sum.nonmated, aes(x = hour_bin, y = Total_Activity)) +
  geom_line() +
  facet_wrap(~Treatment) +
  scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%H:%M") +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Total activity", title = "Non-mated mosquitoes")
```

## Control treatment only

### Mated

```{r}
ggplot(filter(sum.mated, Treatment == "Control"),
       aes(x = hour_bin, y = Total_Activity)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%H:%M") +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Total activity", title = "Mated: Control")
```

### Non-mated

```{r}
ggplot(filter(sum.nonmated, Treatment == "Control"),
       aes(x = hour_bin, y = Total_Activity)) +
  geom_line() +
  scale_x_datetime(date_labels = "%H:%M") +
  labs(x = "Time", y = "Total activity", title = "Non-mated: Control")
```
